v1.0.1-preview.24
- Renamed the shipped JavaScript module to fireForNet-messaging-blazor.js, matching the module name the browser package binds it to.
- Renamed the shipped service worker to fireForNet-messaging-sw-shared.js. The service worker stays a served static web asset: browsers reject a blob or data URL as a service worker script, so it cannot be embedded.

v1.0.1-preview.23
- Synchronized package version with the preview.23 release.

v1.0.1-preview.22
- Web registration omits applicationPubKey when unset (declared per property on the request DTO); null values are otherwise written by default (STJ default shape).

v1.0.1-preview.21
- No functional changes; synchronized with the framework-free MAUI integration sweep.

v1.0.1-preview.20
- Synchronized package version with the preview.20 release.

v1.0.1-preview.19
- Synchronized package version with the preview.19 release.
- Fixed tapping a background notification with a link when the app was not open (cold start). The service worker now persists the click payload in IndexedDB — surviving service-worker termination while a slow Blazor boot completes — and delivers it when the freshly opened page signals its relay listener is ready, instead of posting into the void after a fixed 3-second wait. Held payloads expire after 5 minutes.
- The service worker's notification-click link resolution now falls back to the app origin for Firebase Console notifications (google.c.a.c_id data key), matching the official Web JS SDK.
- The payload mapper now surfaces the notification deep link (RemoteNotification.Link / RemoteMessage.Link).

v1.0.1-preview.18
- Synchronized package version with the preview.18 release.

v1.0.1-preview.17
- Fixed FCM registration failing with HTTP 401 UNAUTHENTICATED. The x-goog-firebase-installations-auth header now uses the official `FIS {token}` scheme (matching the Web JS SDK) instead of `FIS_v2 {token}`. The service worker's cold-start re-registration was updated to match.
- Added a configurable default notification icon. The service worker now resolves relative notification icon/image/badge values to absolute URLs against the app origin, and the new MessagingBlazorOptions.DefaultNotificationIcon is provisioned to the worker as the fallback icon when the payload supplies none.

v1.0.1-preview.16
- Fixed RegisterAsync throwing ArgumentNullException when called without RegisterOptions. Registration with a null options now uses the configured MessagingBlazorOptions.VapidKey as documented (null = defaults), instead of crashing. Added regression tests covering the null-options and explicit-VAPID-key paths.

v1.0.1-preview.15
- Fixed ServiceWorkerPath and ServiceWorkerScope being ignored. The page JS module now accepts (path, scope), and the interop/lifecycle coordinator forward the configured values to navigator.serviceWorker.register. Consuming apps can now point registration at the package's shipped service worker (e.g. /_content/FireForNet.Firebase.Messaging.Blazor/fireForNet-messaging-sw.js) without vendoring a copy into their own wwwroot.

v1.0.1-preview.14
- Initial Blazor Firebase Messaging integration: FID-based registration, foreground/notification event relay, permission management, config-free service worker, capability detection.
- Uses IFirebaseInstallations directly for the FIS auth token and persistent FID.
